notes: I found the real rule: insert `'i'` at index `floor(len(s)/2)` of the **whole string** (not per word). This explains every observation including `"two words"→"two iwords"` (len 9, insert at 4) and `"hello!"→"helilo!"` (len 6, insert at 3), which the per-word vowel rule got wrong. The only special case is all-whitespace input mapping to `"i"`.
